verdict.rationale: Unreal supports bulk/automation workflows via Python editor scripting (asset management, LOD generation, pipeline automation), Unreal Automation Tool, command-line batch operations, and Blueprint/C++ scripting for repetitive tasks across many assets/levels, which collectively enable bulk operations across many items. However, this is achieved via general-purpose scripting/automation tooling rather than a dedicated 'bulk operation' AI-native interface, and there's no evidence of an official MCP server or AI-agent-specific bulk API — community probes note no official Epic MCP and unreliable machine-readability of docs endpoints. missing for 10: a first-party AI-agent-facing bulk-operation API/MCP server, hands-on evidence of an agent performing bulk edits at scale, and confirmation that Python/UAT scripting is reliably accessible to non-interactive agent clients.
